body.title: INI-02 Proactive comms + QoS monitoring: initiative business case (synthetic)

sections.strategicRationale: High complaints -> Journey + service assurance -> complaint rate (B0147). Synthetic demonstration value (illustrative example; not Mobily actual performance).
sections.baselineSummary: May 2026 baseline: complaint rate 3.5 %, 60 SAR per complaint. Synthetic demonstration value (illustrative example; not Mobily actual performance).
sections.interventionsSummary: Proactive pre-travel and in-trip communications, and roaming QoS monitoring.
sections.investmentSummary: Cash: opex 360,000 SAR for proactive communications and QoS monitoring.
sections.benefitsSummary: Avoided care cost 1,584,000 SAR at the annual run-rate at target (formula BF-02).
sections.benefitRamp: Monthly ramp from July 2026 to the December 2026 targets.
sections.recurrenceSummary: Recurring benefit; the investment is approved once.
sections.decisionAskText: Fund INI-02: Cash: opex 360,000 SAR for proactive communications and QoS monitoring. (synthetic demonstration).
